productOverview: Northscan DocAI is a fully managed, off-the-shelf intelligent document processing (IDP) platform that ingests invoices, contracts, and forms, extracts structured fields with pre-trained and custom models, and routes results to downstream ERP/finance systems via API or connectors. Sold as a multi-tenant SaaS with a dedicated-tenant option for regulated customers.
keyCapabilities: Pre-built extraction models for invoices, receipts, purchase orders, and ID documents
Custom model training UI for new document types (no-code labeling)
AI-assisted human-in-the-loop review queue with confidence-based routing
REST API and webhooks for pipeline integration
Native connectors for SAP, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, and Salesforce
Role-based access control, audit trail, and per-tenant data residency options
constraints: Custom model training requires a minimum of 200 labeled samples per document type
Dedicated-tenant (single-tenant) deployment only available on Enterprise plan
Data residency limited to US, EU, and Australia regions at GA
No on-premises deployment option; SaaS only
licensingModel: Annual subscription, tiered by monthly page/document volume plus a one-time onboarding fee for custom model setup.

sla.support: Business hours email/chat (Standard), 24x7 P1 phone support (Enterprise)

security.encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit
